name: codex-slides
description: Run a guided, Browser-first slide workflow in Codex, with durable projects, reusable project templates, Design Files, brand systems, desktop apps, editing, and export.

interface.shortDescription: Build decks step by step in a live Codex Browser workspace.
interface.longDescription: Codex Slides gives Codex a Browser-first slide workflow plus portable Agent Skills and 38 typed MCP tools. Codex opens the product before generation, creates a durable project, tracks navigation-independent runs, and keeps requirements, research, outline approval, visual direction, rendering, editing, verification, speaker notes, project templates, dual-window presenting, and export visible and steerable through exact Browser handoffs. The same local-first workspace ships for web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
capabilities: Durable run start, status, wait, and cancel
Exact Browser slide, panel, version, mode, and run handoffs
Structured intake, verification, and error recovery skills
Design File path copy and download
Electron desktop apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux
